run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T00:57:28Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by the checkout backend being completely unavailable. From about 00:57:38 the otel-demo checkout Deployment runs an unparseable image ("quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0"), so its only pod sits Pending with InvalidImageName and the checkout Service has no ready endpoints. Every /api/checkout request handled by frontend-proxy in 01:00:00-01:05:00 returned HTTP 500 (203 of 203), the frontend's own error spans are exclusively on grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and the /api/checkout route, and the error-span share of frontend-proxy ingress spans rose from ~0 to 2.1% (01:00), 6.0% (01:04) and ~5.6-5.9% (01:06-01:10) - essentially the checkout share of total requests. A small, pre-existing stream of 503 'upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' responses on /api/products and /api/cart (2 in 01:00-01:05) exists but is not the driver of the sustained rate. Resource signals (frontend CPU throttling ~0.23-0.29, frontend-proxy throttling ~0.014-0.029, request rate ~10-13/s) show no step change at 00:57, the flagd fault flags are all off, and no other workload in otel-demo is erroring or unready.

claims.text: frontend-proxy error spans jumped from essentially none to a sustained rate: ingress STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 at 00:55 (5m rate), 0.0681/s at 01:00, and 0.6148/s at 01:05 (egress 'router frontend egress' 0.6074/s), while ingress totals stayed ~12.6/s.
The error share of frontend-proxy 'ingress' spans was 0 at 00:38-00:56 samples, then 0.0210 at 01:00:28, 0.0468 at 01:02:28, 0.0601 at 01:04:28 and 0.0559-0.0586 through 01:10:28 (5m ratio).

At 01:05:00 the only error spans in the trace metrics are on the checkout path: frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' 0.6111/s, frontend 'POST /api/checkout' 0.6111/s, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 0.6111/s, frontend 'tcp.connect' 0.0148/s, plus frontend-proxy ingress 0.6148/s and egress 0.6074/s; cart, product-catalog, ad, payment, currency, shipping, email and other frontend operations all read 0.

In frontend-proxy access logs for 01:00:00-01:05:00 there were 3479 request lines and 203 lines containing 'api/checkout'; 203 lines matched 'api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500', i.e. every checkout request was a 500 (newest at 01:04:59.915Z: "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream).
Before the outage the same route succeeded: 376 frontend-proxy log lines matched 'api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 200' between 00:47:00 and 00:57:00 (newest 00:56:58.846Z).
The otel-demo 'checkout' Service has no ready addresses at all: its endpoints contain only notReadyAddresses for pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (IP 100.96.4.211).

Deployment otel-demo/checkout has spec.replicas 1, no readyReplicas, and pod-template image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" (an invalid reference containing a newline); all other 20 otel-demo Deployments show 1/1 ready with ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-* (or valkey/flagd/otel-collector) images.

Events record the checkout rollout and its failure: Deployment checkout 'Scaled up replica set checkout-d75b77f99 from 0 to 1' at 00:57:45 and 'Scaled down replica set checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0' at 00:57:38; pods checkout-d75b77f99-5mcsx and checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 show InspectFailed 'Failed to apply default image tag "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": ... invalid reference format' and Failed 'Error: InvalidImageName'.

Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 is Pending with container 'checkout' waiting, reason InvalidImageName; every other otel-demo pod is Running and ready with 0 restarts, except fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-xwg9b whose previous container terminated OOMKilled (exit 137) at 00:37:23 and restarted once.

A distinct, low-volume error source exists: frontend-proxy returns 503 UC 'upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' on /api/products and /api/cart - 1 such line in 00:50:00-01:00:00 (00:56:22.296Z) and 2 lines in 01:00:00-01:05:00 - and the same 503 error spans were already present in traces at 00:38-00:45, before the incident.

Traffic and resource signals show no step change at the incident onset: frontend-proxy ingress span rate stayed ~10.3-13.0/s across 00:38-01:11; frontend-proxy CFS throttling was 0.0136-0.0290; frontend CFS throttling was 0.226-0.292; frontend container memory working set grew smoothly from ~120.6MB to ~128.9MB against a 200Mi limit.

The flagd feature-flag ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (key demo.flagd.json) has every fault-type flag at defaultVariant "off": adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure.
All five cluster nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure=False and DiskPressure=False at query time.

Background error spans before the incident were negligible and unrelated to checkout: at 00:55:00 the largest non-proxy error rates were ad 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' 0.00175/s and recommendation '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' 0.00175/s, with frontend-proxy egress 0 and ingress 0.00702/s.

Mechanism: the checkout Deployment rollout replaced the only working checkout pod with pods that cannot start, so the checkout Service has no ready endpoints; the frontend's PlaceOrder gRPC call (and its tcp.connect) fails, the frontend answers /api/checkout with HTTP 500, and frontend-proxy records those 500s as ingress/egress STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans, producing the sustained error rate the alert reports.

Rejected: frontend or frontend-proxy resource exhaustion/CPU throttling caused the error rate. Throttling ratios for both pods are flat across the window, frontend memory stays ~61-64% of its 200Mi limit, request rate is steady, and the error spikes are exclusively 500s on the checkout path rather than delay or general failure.

Rejected: a flagd feature-flag fault (adFailure, cartFailure, paymentFailure, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, imageSlowLoad, etc.) drove the errors. All flags read as defaultVariant "off", cart/product-catalog/ad/payment span error rates are 0 and traffic rate is unchanged; no flag was observed on.

Rejected: the fraud-detection container OOMKill (exit 137 at 00:37:23, one restart) explains the alert. It occurred about 20 minutes before the error ramp, the pod is now Running/ready, and its only error series is a low-rate flagd EventStream stream (0.0037/s), with no checkout-path errors attributable to it.

Checked and healthy with respect to this failure: with the exception of the checkout path, all frontend operations and all other otel-demo services show 0 error-span rate at 01:05:00, and 20 of 21 otel-demo Deployments report 1/1 ready replicas.

Restore Deployment otel-demo/checkout to a valid image (e.g. ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) so a checkout pod becomes Ready, then verify that /api/checkout returns 200 and that frontend-proxy ingress error rate falls back to its pre-00:57 level.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not present in the queried Prometheus: both list_prometheus_rules queries (rule_name=RequestErrorRate and type=alert) returned no rules, so the exact expression, window and threshold behind 'current: 2.0444' are unknown; linking 500 responses to that metric is inferred from the match between the ~5.8% checkout share of requests and the observed 5.6-6.0% error-span ratio.

Jaeger traces stop at about 2026-11-18T00:45:31Z (source_end_at of the trace queries), so no trace spans describe the post-00:57 failure; incident-period evidence comes from Prometheus and frontend-proxy logs only, and the 503-reset traces cited are from 00:38-00:45.
The frontend container produced no stdout/stderr lines in 00:50-01:05 (0 bytes read), so the frontend application's own error messages for the failed checkout calls could not be read.

No record exists of when or by whom the checkout Deployment pod template was changed: Kubernetes events only show the resulting rollout (00:57:35-00:57:45) and the current spec image is read at query time; the change_history integration is not available in this Run.

The alert started at 00:57:28Z, about 10 seconds before the old checkout pod was deleted (00:57:38Z); the first failing checkout request and whether any pre-existing 503 reset triggered the initial breach are not observable.

The 503 'upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' responses from the frontend to frontend-proxy (2 in 01:00-01:05 plus earlier ones) are a separate, low-volume condition whose upstream cause could not be determined from the available signals (no frontend logs, no post-00:45 traces).
next_steps: Repair the checkout Deployment image reference (remove the embedded newline / use the demo's 2.1.3-checkout image) and confirm a checkout pod becomes Ready and joins the Service endpoints.

If desired, correct the 503 connection-reset noise separately by inspecting frontend upstream keep-alive/CPU settings and Envoy upstream idle timeouts, since it predates and is independent of the checkout outage.
Confirm with the owner of the otel-demo cluster who edited the checkout Deployment spec around 2026-11-18T00:57Z, since change history is not available to this investigation.
